  "name": "默认 AI 预审规则",

  "dimensions": [
    {
      "key": "accuracy",

      "maxScore": 100
    }
  ],
  "passThreshold": 80,
  "manualThreshold": 60,
  "provider": "deepseek",
  "model": "deepseek-chat",
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "actorId": "{{agentId}}"
}
